records.summary_text: India demands real caution from trans visitors, with a complex mix of constitutional protection and real practical gaps. Same-sex acts were decriminalised in 2018, courts are protective, and same-sex marriage is not legal although courts have acknowledged same-sex couples as family units — the partner-travel baseline.
